messages.subject: Combining poppr.amova and missingno functions
parts:
I am trying to have the poppr.amova ignore the missing values in my dataset, but I am having trouble figuring out how to integrate the missingno and poppr.amova code:


This does not work:  
Amova_myData <- poppr.amova(myData, ~Pop, (missingno(myData, type = "ignore", cutoff = 0.05, quiet = FALSE, freq = FALSE)))
I get this error: 
Error in if (clonecorrect) { : argument is not interpretable as logical


This also does not work:
myData<-missingno(myData, type = "ignore", cutoff = 0.05, quiet = FALSE, freq = FALSE)
Amova_myData <- poppr.amova(myData, ~Pop)
The data had not been ignored, and was considered missing.


Suggestions?  I believe solving this problem may address the question I had posted (and deleted) earlier, about having negative values in the AMOVA variance explained.
